propositions: Bridge must transition from continuous re-dispatch (RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS=false) to hourly schedule entry '23 * * * *' to free the runner and align with operator directive.

CloudWatch alarm bridge_run_failures is structurally unfirable at hourly cadence with threshold=1 and must be retuned to threshold=0, evaluation_periods=2, datapoints_to_alarm=2 to detect sustained failures without false negatives.
Cadence test must derive fire times from workflow cron and assert exactly 60-minute gaps, one schedule entry, and non-zero minute rather than echoing literals.
All references to 40-minute bridge cadence in code comments, docstrings, and docs must be updated to reflect 1-hour worst-case latency and hourly cadence.
Terraform plan detects monitoring_bridge.tf changes and blocks merge until terraform apply is executed by operator with AWS credentials.
